```{r, eval=T, echo=F}
# Read in snakefile to find cofgi file
snakefile<-readLines('Snakefile')

# Read in config file
configfile<-snakefile[grepl('config', snakefile)]
configfile<-gsub('\"','',gsub('.* \\"','',configfile))
config<-readLines(configfile)

# Determine which analyses were requested
clump_logical<-config[grepl('clump:',config)] == "clump: T"

cojo_logical<-config[grepl('cojo:',config)] == "cojo: T"

finemap_logical<-config[grepl('finemap:',config)] == "finemap: T"

ldsc_logical<-config[grepl('ldsc:',config)] == "ldsc: T"

magma_gene_logical<-config[grepl('magma_gene:',config)] == "magma_gene: T"

twas_panel_psychencode_logical<-config[grepl('twas_panel_psychencode:',config)] == "twas_panel_psychencode: T"
twas_panel_fusion_logical<-config[grepl('twas_panel_fusion:',config)] == "twas_panel_fusion: T"

twas_logical<-any(twas_panel_psychencode_logical, twas_panel_fusion_logical)

twas_conditional_logical<-config[grepl('twas_conditional:',config)] == "twas_conditional: T" & twas_logical == T

smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_psychencode:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_psychencode: T"

smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord: T"

pwas_panel_rosmap_logical<-config[grepl('pwas_panel_rosmap:',config)] == "pwas_panel_rosmap: T"
pwas_panel_banner_logical<-config[grepl('pwas_panel_banner:',config)] == "pwas_panel_banner: T"

smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical<-config[grepl('smr_protein_panel_rosmap:',config)] == "smr_protein_panel_rosmap: T"

magma_drugtargetor_logical<-config[grepl('magma_drugtargetor:',config)] == "magma_drugtargetor: T"
twas_gsea_lincs_logical<-config[grepl('twas_gsea_lincs:',config)] == "twas_gsea_lincs: T"
twas_so_lincs_logical<-config[grepl('twas_so_lincs:',config)] == "twas_so_lincs: T"

# Summarise this information
mol_assoc_logical<-any(magma_gene_logical,
                       twas_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical,
                       pwas_panel_rosmap_logical,
                       pwas_panel_banner_logical,
                       smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical)

expression_logical<-any( twas_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical)

psychencode_logical<-any(twas_panel_psychencode_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical)

metabrain_logical<-any(smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical)

protein_logical<-any( pwas_panel_rosmap_logical,
                      pwas_panel_banner_logical,
                      smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical)

drug_logical<-any(magma_drugtargetor_logical,
                  twas_gsea_lincs_logical,
                  twas_so_lincs_logical)

```

```{r,  results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=any(clump_logical, cojo_logical)}

cat("*** \n")
cat("# SNP associations \n")
cat("This section list independent SNP associations achieving either genome-wide or suggestive significance. Independence is determined using [LD-based clumping](https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink/1.9/postproc#clump) and/or conditional-joint ([COJO](https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#COJO](https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#COJO)) analysis. Note, LD is estimated using a reference sample and may not accurately reflect the LD structure in the GWAS sample. COJO analysis is particularly sensitive to LD mispecification. \n")

```



```{r, echo=F, eval=twas_logical}

twas_all<-fread(paste0('results/',params$gwas,'/twas/',params$gwas,'_twas_GW_clean.txt.gz'))
twas_all$FILE<-NULL
twas_all$MODEL<-NULL

twas_all_clean<-twas_all

# Calculate P accounting for multiple testing
twas_all_clean$TWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(twas_all_clean$TWAS.P, method='BY')
twas_all_clean<-twas_all_clean[,c('CHR','P0','P1','ensembl_gene_id','external_gene_name','PANEL','TWAS.Z','TWAS.P','TWAS.P.FDR','COLOC.PP3','COLOC.PP4'), with=T]
names(twas_all_clean)[names(twas_all_clean) == 'ensembl_gene_id']<-'Ensembl ID'
names(twas_all_clean)[names(twas_all_clean) == 'external_gene_name']<-'Gene Symbol'
twas_all_clean<-twas_all_clean[which(twas_all_clean$TWAS.P.FDR < 0.05 & (twas_all_clean$COLOC.PP4-twas_all_clean$COLOC.PP3)/twas_all_clean$COLOC.PP4 > 0.8),]

twas_all_clean<-twas_all_clean[order(twas_all_clean$CHR, twas_all_clean$P0),]

twas_all_clean$TWAS.Z<-round(twas_all_clean$TWAS.Z, 3)
twas_all_clean$TWAS.P<-format(twas_all_clean$TWAS.P, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
twas_all_clean$TWAS.P.FDR<-format(twas_all_clean$TWAS.P.FDR, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

datatable(twas_all_clean, rownames= FALSE)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=twas_logical, results='asis'}

cat(paste0('Full results file: results/',params$gwas,'/twas/',params$gwas,'_twas_GW_clean.txt.gz \n\n'))
cat(paste0("Note. CHR = Chromsome; P0 = Gene start; P1 = Gene end; PANEL = Gene expression panel; TWAS.Z = TWAS Z-score; TWAS.P = TWAS p-value; TWAS.P.FDR = BY FDR corrected TWAS p-value; COLOC.PP3 = Posterior probability of coloc model 3 (linkage); COLOC.PP4 = Posterior probability of coloc model 4 (pleiotropy)."))

```

```{r, echo=F, eval=twas_panel_psychencode_logical & smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical}
psychencode_smr_twas<-merge(
    twas_psychencode[,c('ensembl_gene_id','external_gene_name','TWAS.Z','TWAS.P','COLOC.PP3','COLOC.PP4'), with=F],
    smr_psychencode[,c('probeID', 'b_SMR','p_SMR','p_HEIDI'),with=F], 
    by.x='ensembl_gene_id', by.y='probeID', all=T)

psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P, method='BY')
psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR.FDR<-p.adjust(psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR, method='BY')
  
psychencode_smr_twas<-psychencode_smr_twas[,c('ensembl_gene_id','external_gene_name','TWAS.Z','TWAS.P','TWAS.P.FDR','COLOC.PP3','COLOC.PP4','b_SMR','p_SMR','p_SMR.FDR','p_HEIDI'), with=F]
names(psychencode_smr_twas)[1:2]<-c('Ensembl ID','Gene Symbol')

psychencode_smr_twas<-psychencode_smr_twas[(psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P.FDR < 0.05 & (psychencode_smr_twas$COLOC.PP4-psychencode_smr_twas$COLOC.PP3)/psychencode_smr_twas$COLOC.PP4 > 0.8) | (psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR.FDR < 0.05 & psychencode_smr_twas$p_HEIDI > 0.05),]

color.me <- which(  psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P.FDR < 0.05 & 
                    (psychencode_smr_twas$COLOC.PP4-psychencode_smr_twas$COLOC.PP3)/psychencode_smr_twas$COLOC.PP4 > 0.8 & 
                    psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR.FDR < 0.05 & 
                    psychencode_smr_twas$p_HEIDI > 0.05 &
                    sign(psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.Z) == sign(psychencode_smr_twas$b_SMR))

psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.Z<-round(psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.Z, 3)
psychencode_smr_twas$b_SMR<-round(psychencode_smr_twas$b_SMR, 3)
psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P<-format(psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P.FDR<-format(psychencode_smr_twas$TWAS.P.FDR, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR<-format(psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR.FDR<-format(psychencode_smr_twas$p_SMR.FDR, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
psychencode_smr_twas$p_HEIDI<-format(psychencode_smr_twas$p_HEIDI, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

psychencode_smr_twas %>% 
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling() %>%
  row_spec(color.me, bold = T, color = "green")

```

```{r, echo=F, eval=pwas_panel_rosmap_logical}
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=F, eval=all(pwas_panel_rosmap_logical, pwas_panel_banner_logical)}
pwas_rosmap_banner$`Gene Symbol.x`[is.na(pwas_rosmap_banner$`Gene Symbol.x`)]<-pwas_rosmap_banner$`Gene Symbol.y`[is.na(pwas_rosmap_banner$`Gene Symbol.x`)]

names(pwas_rosmap_banner)[names(pwas_rosmap_banner) == "Gene Symbol.x"]<-"Gene Symbol"
pwas_rosmap_banner$`Gene Symbol.y`<-NULL

pwas_rosmap_banner<-pwas_rosmap_banner[which((pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.x & (pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.x-pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP3.x)/pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.x > 0.8) | (pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.y & (pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.y-pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP3.y)/pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.y > 0.8)),]

color.me <- which(  pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.P.FDR.x < 0.05 & 
                    (pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.x-pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP3.x)/pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.x > 0.8 & 
                    pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.P.FDR.y < 0.05 & 
                    (pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.y-pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP3.y)/pwas_rosmap_banner$COLOC.PP4.y > 0.8 &
                    sign(pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.Z.x) == sign(pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.Z.y))

pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.P.FDR.x<-format(pwas_banner_clean$TWAS.P.FDR.x, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.P.y<-format(pwas_banner_clean$TWAS.P.y, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.Z.x<-round(pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.Z.x)
pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.Z.y<-round(pwas_rosmap_banner$TWAS.Z.y)

names(pwas_rosmap_banner)<-gsub('\\.x', " (ROSMAP)", names(pwas_rosmap_banner))
```

```{r, eval=any(expression_logical,protein_logical), echo=F}

all_func_res<-NULL
types<-NULL

if(finemap_logical){
  finemap_tmp<-data.frame(Panel = 'SuSie',
                          ID=unlist(strsplit(finemap$Gene, ', ')),
                          Z=1,
                          Sig=F,
                          Coloc=F,
                          Method='SNP\nFine-mapping',
                          Type='')
  
  finemap_tmp<-finemap_tmp[finemap_tmp$ID != 'None',]
  
    all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, finemap_tmp)

    types<-c(types, "SuSiE")
}

if(twas_logical){
  
  # TWAS
  twas_tmp<-twas_all[,c('PANEL','external_gene_name','TWAS.Z'), with=F]
  twas_tmp$Sig<-p.adjust(twas_all$TWAS.P, method='BY') < 0.05
  twas_tmp$Coloc<-(twas_all$COLOC.PP4-twas_all$COLOC.PP3)/twas_all$COLOC.PP4 > 0.8
  names(twas_tmp)<-c('Panel','ID','Z','Sig','Coloc')
  twas_tmp$Method<-'FUSION'
  twas_tmp$Type<-'Expr.'
  twas_tmp$Type[grepl('SPLIC',twas_tmp$Panel)]<-'Splice'
  # Retain only the most significant assoc for each gene within PANEL (only relevent for splice panel)
  twas_tmp<-twas_tmp[order(-abs(twas_tmp$Z)),]
  twas_tmp<-twas_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(twas_tmp$Panel, twas_tmp$ID)),]
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, twas_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "FUSION\nExpr.")
  if(any(twas_tmp$Type == 'Splice')){
    types<-c(types, "FUSION\nSplice")
  }
}

if(smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical){
  # SMR expression
  smr_psychencode_2<-smr_psychencode
  smr_psychencode_2$PANEL<-'PsychENCODE DLPFC'
  smr_psychencode_2$Z<-smr_psychencode_2$b_SMR/smr_psychencode_2$se_SMR
  smr_psychencode_2<-smr_psychencode_2[,c('PANEL','Gene','Z','p_SMR','p_HEIDI'), with =T]
}

if(metabrain_logical){
  
  smr_metabrain_all_2<-smr_metabrain_all
  smr_metabrain_all_2$PANEL<-paste0('MetaBrain ',smr_metabrain_all_2$PANEL)
  smr_metabrain_all_2$Z<-smr_metabrain_all_2$b_SMR/smr_metabrain_all_2$se_SMR
  smr_metabrain_all_2<-smr_metabrain_all_2[,c('PANEL','external_gene_name','Z','p_SMR','p_HEIDI'), with =T]
  names(smr_metabrain_all_2)<-c('PANEL','Gene','Z','p_SMR','p_HEIDI')

}

if(all(smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical, metabrain_logical)){
  
  smr_res_dat<-rbind(smr_psychencode_2,smr_metabrain_all_2)
  
}

if(smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical == T & metabrain_logical == F){
  smr_res_dat<-smr_psychencode_2
}

if(smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical == F & metabrain_logical == T){
  smr_res_dat<-smr_metabrain_all_2
}

if(any(smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical, metabrain_logical)){

  smr_res_dat$Sig<-p.adjust(smr_res_dat$p_SMR, method = 'BY') < 0.05
  smr_res_dat$Coloc<-smr_res_dat$p_HEIDI > 0.05
  smr_tmp<-smr_res_dat[,c('PANEL','Gene','Z','Sig','Coloc'), with=F]
  names(smr_tmp)<-c('Panel','ID','Z','Sig','Coloc')
  smr_tmp$Method<-'SMR'
  smr_tmp$Type<-'Expr.'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, smr_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "SMR\nExpr.")
}

# PWAS
if(pwas_panel_rosmap_logical){
  
  pwas_rosmap_tmp<-pwas_rosmap
  pwas_rosmap_tmp<-pwas_rosmap_tmp[,c('Gene Symbol','TWAS.Z'), with=F]
  pwas_rosmap_tmp$Sig<-pwas_rosmap$TWAS.P.FDR < 0.05
  pwas_rosmap_tmp$Coloc<-(pwas_rosmap$COLOC.PP4-pwas_rosmap$COLOC.PP3)/pwas_rosmap$COLOC.PP4 > 0.8
  pwas_rosmap_tmp$PANEL<-'ROSMAP DLPFC'
  pwas_rosmap_tmp<-pwas_rosmap_tmp[,c('PANEL','Gene Symbol','TWAS.Z','Sig','Coloc'), with=F]
  names(pwas_rosmap_tmp)<-c('Panel','ID','Z','Sig','Coloc')
  pwas_rosmap_tmp<-pwas_rosmap_tmp[order(-abs(pwas_rosmap_tmp$Z)),]
  pwas_rosmap_tmp<-pwas_rosmap_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(pwas_rosmap_tmp$Panel, pwas_rosmap_tmp$ID)),]
  pwas_rosmap_tmp$Method<-'FUSION'
  pwas_rosmap_tmp$Type<-'Protein'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, pwas_rosmap_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "FUSION\nProtein")
}

if(pwas_panel_banner_logical){
  
  pwas_banner_tmp<-pwas_banner
  pwas_banner_tmp<-pwas_banner_tmp[,c('Gene Symbol','TWAS.Z'), with=F]
  pwas_banner_tmp$Sig<-pwas_banner$TWAS.P.FDR < 0.05
  pwas_banner_tmp$Coloc<-(pwas_banner$COLOC.PP4-pwas_banner$COLOC.PP3)/pwas_banner$COLOC.PP4 > 0.8
  pwas_banner_tmp$PANEL<-'Banner DLPFC'
  pwas_banner_tmp<-pwas_banner_tmp[,c('PANEL','Gene Symbol','TWAS.Z','Sig','Coloc'), with=F]
  names(pwas_banner_tmp)<-c('Panel','ID','Z','Sig','Coloc')
  pwas_banner_tmp<-pwas_banner_tmp[order(-abs(pwas_banner_tmp$Z)),]
  pwas_banner_tmp<-pwas_banner_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(pwas_banner_tmp$Panel, pwas_banner_tmp$ID)),]
  pwas_banner_tmp$Method<-'FUSION'
  pwas_banner_tmp$Type<-'Protein'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, pwas_banner_tmp)
  types<-c(types, "FUSION\nProtein")
}

if(smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical){
  
  # SMR protein
  smr_rosmap_tmp<-smr_rosmap
  smr_rosmap_tmp$z_SMR<-abs(qnorm(as.numeric(smr_rosmap_tmp$p_SMR)/2))
  smr_rosmap_tmp$z_SMR<-sign(smr_rosmap_tmp$b_SMR)*smr_rosmap_tmp$z_SMR
  
  smr_rosmap_tmp<-smr_rosmap_tmp[,c('Gene Symbol','z_SMR'), with=F]
  smr_rosmap_tmp$Sig<-as.numeric(smr_rosmap$p_SMR.FDR < 0.05)
  smr_rosmap_tmp$Coloc<-as.numeric(smr_rosmap$p_HEIDI > 0.05)
  smr_rosmap_tmp$PANEL<-'ROSMAP DLPFC'
  smr_rosmap_tmp<-smr_rosmap_tmp[,c('PANEL','Gene Symbol','z_SMR','Sig','Coloc'), with=F]
  names(smr_rosmap_tmp)<-c('Panel','ID','Z','Sig','Coloc')
  smr_rosmap_tmp<-smr_rosmap_tmp[order(-abs(smr_rosmap_tmp$Z)),]
  smr_rosmap_tmp<-smr_rosmap_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(smr_rosmap_tmp$Panel, smr_rosmap_tmp$ID)),]
  smr_rosmap_tmp$Method<-'SMR'
  smr_rosmap_tmp$Type<-'Protein'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, smr_rosmap_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "SMR\nProtein")
}

types<-unique(types)

if(magma_gene_logical){
  magma_tmp<-data.frame(Panel = 'MAGMA',
                          ID=magma$ID,
                          Z=abs(qnorm(as.numeric(magma$P))),
                          Sig=as.numeric(magma$P.FDR) < 0.05,
                          Coloc=F,
                          Method='MAGMA',
                          Type='')
  
    all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, magma_tmp)

    types<-c(types, "MAGMA")
}

if(clump_logical){
  nearest_tmp<-data.frame(Panel = 'NearestGene',
                          ID=gsub(' .*','',gsub(',.*','',clump_lead_snps_gw$NearestGene)),
                          Z=1,
                          Sig=F,
                          Coloc=F,
                          Method='Nearest\nGene',
                          Type='')
  
    all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, nearest_tmp)

    types<-c(types, "Nearest\nGene")
}

# Subset to high confidence genes
all_func_res<-all_func_res[all_func_res$ID %in% all_func_res$ID[(all_func_res$Sig == T & all_func_res$Coloc == T) | all_func_res$Method == 'SNP\nFine-mapping'],]

# Remove missing values
all_func_res<-all_func_res[complete.cases(all_func_res),]

all_func_res$Group<-paste0(all_func_res$Method,'\n',all_func_res$Type )
all_func_res$Group[all_func_res$Group == 'SNP\nFine-mapping\n']<-'SuSiE'
all_func_res$Group[all_func_res$Group == 'MAGMA\n']<-'MAGMA'
all_func_res$Group[all_func_res$Group == 'Nearest\nGene\n']<-'Nearest\nGene'
all_func_res$Group<-factor(all_func_res$Group, levels=types)

all_func_res$ID<-factor(all_func_res$ID, levels=rev(levels(factor(all_func_res$ID))))

# Create heatmap
library(ggplot2)

heatmap<-ggplot(data = all_func_res, aes(x = Panel, y = ID)) +
	theme_bw()	+
	geom_tile(data=all_func_res[all_func_res$Method != 'SNP\nFine-mapping' & all_func_res$Method != 'Nearest\nGene',], aes(fill = Z), width=0.95, height=0.95) +
  geom_tile(data=all_func_res[all_func_res$Sig == T,], aes(x = Panel, y = ID), colour='black', fill=NA, size=0.3, width=0.95, height=0.95) +
  geom_tile(data=all_func_res[all_func_res$Coloc ==T & all_func_res$Sig == T,], aes(x = Panel, y = ID), colour='green2', fill=NA, size=0.3, width=0.95, height=0.95) +
	scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("dodgerblue2","white","red"), na.value = 'white',name = "Z-score") +
	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x='', y='') +
	geom_text(data=all_func_res[all_func_res$Method != 'SNP\nFine-mapping' & all_func_res$Method != 'Nearest\nGene',], aes(label=round(Z,1)), color="black", size=3) +
  geom_tile(data=all_func_res[all_func_res$Method == 'SNP\nFine-mapping' | all_func_res$Method == 'Nearest\nGene',], aes(x = Panel, y = ID), fill='springgreen3', width=0.5, height=0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ Group , nrow=1, scales = "free_x")

group_siz<-NULL
for(i in types){
  group_siz<-rbind(group_siz, data.frame(Group=i,
                           Size=length(unique(all_func_res$Panel[all_func_res$Group==i]))))
}

# Set minimum size to 3 to allow space for labels
group_siz$Size[group_siz$Size < 2]<-2
group_siz$Prop<-group_siz$Size/sum(group_siz$Size)
group_siz$Width<-4*group_siz$Prop

library(grid)
gt = ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(heatmap))

for(i in 1:nrow(group_siz)){
  gt$widths[gt$layout$l[grep(paste0('panel-',i,'-1'), gt$layout$name)]] = group_siz$Width[i]*gt$widths[gt$layout$l[grep(paste0('panel-',i,'-1'), gt$layout$name)]]

}

png(paste0('results/',params$gwas,'/reports/gene_con_func_heatmap.png'), units = 'px', res=300, height=65*length(unique(all_func_res$ID))+300, width=3250)

grid.draw(gt)

a<-dev.off()

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=any(twas_so_lincs_logical, twas_gsea_lincs_logical, magma_drugtargetor_logical)}
cat("# Drug repurposing \n")
cat("This section shows results drug repurposing analyses. Several analysis approaches are available. The inferred differential expression results from TWAS can be compared to the drug-induced expression profiles from the [Connectivity Map](https://clue.io/), AKA LINCS, to identify drugs that induce expression profiles opposite expression profiles associated with the GWAS phenotype. Two methods are used to compare TWAS and CMAP profiles, including the [average rank based method from So et al.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28805813/) and [TWAS-GSEA from Pain et al](https://github.com/opain/TWAS-GSEA). An alternative approach is to use MAGMA to identify drugs that are enriched for connections to genes associated with the GWAS phenotype. We use the collection of bipartite gene-drug interactions collated by [DrugTargetor](https://drugtargetor.com/). Unlike the TWAS-CMAP approaches, the MAGMA based approach does not consider the direction of effect of the gene on the GWAS phenotype or the drug on the genes expression/function, so may highlight drugs that might increase risk of the GWAS phenotype. However, the MAGMA approach can use a broader and perhaps more reliable sources of drug-gene interaction databases. To help validate the approaches used for identifying drug repurposing oppurtunities, we test for enrichment of drugs within ATC classifications. \n\n")

```

```{r, echo=F, eval=magma_drugtargetor_logical}

magma_gs<-fread(paste0('results/',params$gwas,'/magma/magma_drug_targetor.clean.csv'))
magma_gs<-magma_gs[order(magma_gs$P),]
magma_gs$P.FDR<-p.adjust(magma_gs$P, method='fdr')

if(sum(magma_gs$P.FDR < 0.05) >= 250){
  magma_gs<-magma_gs[magma_gs$P.FDR < 0.05,]
} else {
  magma_gs<-magma_gs[1:250,]
}
  
magma_gs$P<-format(magma_gs$P, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
magma_gs$P.FDR<-format(magma_gs$P.FDR, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

magma_gs$NAME<-paste(toupper(substr(magma_gs$NAME, 1, 1)), substr(magma_gs$NAME, 2, nchar(magma_gs$NAME)), sep="")

for(i in 1:nrow(magma_gs)){
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(magma_gs$ATC[i], ','))
  tmp<-substr(tmp, 1, 4)
  tmp2<-atc_labels[atc_labels$Code %in% tmp]$Name
  if(length(tmp) > 1){
    magma_gs$ATC_code[i]<-paste0(tmp, collapse=';')
    magma_gs$ATC_desc[i]<-paste0(tmp2, collapse=';')
  } else {
    magma_gs$ATC_code[i]<-tmp
    magma_gs$ATC_desc[i]<-tmp2

  }
}

magma_gs<-magma_gs[,c("NAME","NGENES","BETA","SE","P","P.FDR",'ATC_code','ATC_desc') , with=F]
names(magma_gs)<-c('Name','N Genes',"BETA","SE",'P','P.FDR','ATC Code','ATC Description')

magma_gs$Name<-paste0('<a href="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/g/#search_results/all/query=',magma_gs$Name,'">',magma_gs$Name,'</a>')

datatable(magma_gs, rownames= FALSE, escape = -1)

```

```{r, echo=F, eval=all(twas_gsea_lincs_logical, twas_so_lincs_logical)}

so_cmap<-fread(paste0('results/',params$gwas,'/twas/cmap/So_res_clean.csv'))
gsea_cmap<-fread(paste0('results/',params$gwas,'/twas/cmap/twas_gsea_cmap.competitive.clean.csv'))

both_cmap<-merge(so_cmap, gsea_cmap[,c('sig_id','Estimate','SE','P','P.CORR'),with=F], by='sig_id')

ggplot(both_cmap, aes(x=-log10(both_cmap$p), y=-log10(both_cmap$P))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_half_open() +
  geom_abline(intercept =0 , slope = 1) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x="-log10(P)(Average Ranks)", y='-log10(P)(TWAS-GSEA)')
```
